properties.statement:
FIVE OBSERVED INSTANCES IN ONE SESSION, 2026-08-30, giving a parked idea its first evidence. `dec:idea-a-prose-field-silently-absorbed-tool-call-markup` has sat with NO LINKS since it was recorded — `detect_defects` reports it as an orphan — because nobody had a measured occurrence to attach. This is that.

═══ THE SHAPE, AND IT IS NARROWER THAN THE PARKED IDEA FEARED ═══

In every case the agent's tool-call markup was malformed at the END of the call, and the damage landed on the LAST prose field. Fields did not collapse into each other; earlier fields were untouched every time.

  · `dec:idea-who-authors-the-domain-artifact` — `</rationale>` and `</invoke>` written into the tail of `rationale`.
  · `dec:a-brainstormed-idea-is-a-first-class-kind` — same two tags, same field, same position.
  · `chg:the-relatedness-judgement-rides-the-refusal` — `</summary>` plus an entire `<parameter name="rationale">` opening tag absorbed into `summary`, and the rationale therefore never arrived as a field at all.

⭐ THE SPLIT IS THE FINDING, AND IT IS REFLOW2'S OWN DOCTRINE SHOWING UP AS DATA.

Two further instances behaved COMPLETELY DIFFERENTLY. Two `report_manual_work` calls carried the same class of malformed markup, and both were REFUSED outright — `failed to deserialize parameters: missing field \`diagnosis\``. Nothing was stored, and the agent knew immediately.

The difference is not the agent and not the harness. It is WHAT THE FIELD IS:

    FREE PROSE  (`rationale`, `summary`)  — 3 of 3 SILENTLY STORED THE GARBAGE
    REQUIRED TYPED (`diagnosis`, an enum) — 2 of 2 REFUSED LOUDLY

A property bag accepts whatever arrives, so a mangled prose field is indistinguishable from prose somebody meant. A required enum has a shape to fail against. THIS IS THE SAME ARGUMENT REFLOW2 ALREADY MAKES ABOUT TYPED TOOLS VERSUS INSTRUCTIONS, arriving from the other direction: the typed field is what noticed.

═══ WHAT IT COST HERE ═══
All five were caught by reading the tool's echoed reply, which is the habit `rule:success-is-read-from-the-authoritative-object` exists to install — not by any check. Cost was one corrective call each. In the `summary` case the rationale was LOST rather than mangled: the field was never sent, so a reader would have seen a change event with no reasoning and nothing would have said one was intended.

⚠️ NOT ESTABLISHED, and the limits matter for whether anything should be built:
· WHOSE DEFECT IT IS. The malformed markup originates in the AGENT'S emission, not in reflow2. reflow2's contribution is that a free-text field cannot refuse a value — which is arguably correct behaviour for a property bag, not a bug.
· Whether it is detectable at all. A heuristic refusing prose containing `</` or `<parameter` would fire on any design that legitimately discusses XML, tool schemas or HTML — and this graph discusses tool schemas constantly.
· Whether five in one session is a rate or an outlier. One session, one agent, one model. Nothing says whether this is common.
· Whether the same bleed reaches OTHER free-text fields — `statement`, `decision`, `description`, `findings`. Only `rationale` and `summary` were observed, and only because they happened to be last.
